record.aggregation_rule: Sum authoritative lifecycle states; scheduled is requested matches times four. Pending matches remain unstarted on interruption.
Wins divided by completed games including draws; failures and skipped games excluded.
Wins divided by completed matches including ties; incomplete matches excluded.
Same completed-game denominator, partitioned by pre_side/post_side.

Event count counts selected choices. Player-games are deduplicated per player/card/action, including draws. Opportunities and declines are deduplicated per prompt/card/action, including repeated prompts.
Raw chain event counts per observer; successful_resolutions counts normal CHAIN_SOLVED links from their controller perspective only, with permitted source identity.
Public material attach/detach observations per observer; no inferred fusion/synchro usage or cost classification.
Raw named public event occurrences per observer, with no quality score.
Sum submitted legal exchange records; records partition player/card/direction/reason. No causal effectiveness inferred.
Count bot-provided reasons for completed-game own decisions.

Cold initialization separately timed. Exact nearest-rank game latency includes mandatory evidence persistence. Decision histogram uses bounded log buckets. Peak memory is maximum sampled combined supervisor/host RSS. Throughput includes batch orchestration and evidence I/O. Aggregate elapsed/write/bridge/peak metrics are null when a resumed process has no complete earlier timing checkpoint; game latency remains reconstructible from persisted game records.
Failed game and sideboarding categories counted separately from competitive outcomes; cleanup counts explicit host acknowledgements.
Match-cluster sandwich variance with normal 95 percent interval. All completed games within one match form one cluster; estimates null below two informative matches.

performance.measurement_boundary: Game dispatch before engine handle creation through canonical hashing, XML serialization, XSD validation, atomic file fsync/rename and progress fsync. Match elapsed additionally includes sideboarding, match finalization and aggregation; end_to_end_ms includes cold startup and stops before summary/report persistence.
